sname: ビジネス交渉・応用編
title: ビジネス交渉・応用編（長い掛け合い）

items.en: Let's cut to the chase. We need the units by the fifteenth.
items.jp: 単刀直入にいこう。15日までに製品が必要です。
items.speak: Let's cut to the chase. We need the units by the fifteenth.

items.en: That'd mean overtime shifts, and overtime costs money.
items.jp: それは残業シフトを意味して、残業は費用がかかります。
items.speak: That'd mean overtime shifts, and overtime costs money.

items.en: Eight percent is steep. What if we place a bigger order next quarter?
items.jp: 8%は高い。次の四半期に大きな注文を出したらどう？
items.speak: Eight percent is steep. What if we place a bigger order next quarter?

items.en: Now we're talking. How much bigger are we talking about?
items.jp: それなら話は別だ。どのくらい大きいの？
items.speak: Now we're talking. How much bigger are we talking about?

items.en: Lemme check with my boss, and I'll get back to you by three.
items.jp: 上司に確認して、3時までに折り返します。
items.speak: Lemme check with my boss, and I'll get back to you by three.
items.note: 元の形: let me／聞こえ方: レミ／使う場面:確認すると言う時

items.en: Gimme a day to run the numbers. I don't wanna promise too much.
items.jp: 計算する時間を1日ください。約束しすぎたくないので。
items.speak: Gimme a day to run the numbers. I don't wanna promise too much.
items.note: 元の形: give me／want to／聞こえ方: ギミ／ワナ／使う場面:時間をもらう時

items.en: I'm not gonna lie, that's a tough number to swallow.
items.jp: 正直に言うと、その数字は飲み込みにくい。
items.speak: I'm not gonna lie, that's a tough number to swallow.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:本音を言う時

items.en: We were told the price included installation. It's in the email.
items.jp: 設置込みの価格と聞いていた。メールに書いてある。
items.speak: We were told the price included installation. It's in the email.

items.en: I won't pretend otherwise. If that's what he wrote, we'll honor it.
items.jp: そうでないふりはしません。彼がそう書いたなら、従います。
items.speak: I won't pretend otherwise. If that's what he wrote, we'll honor it.

items.en: Walking away costs both of us, so let's try to avoid that.
items.jp: 手を引けば双方に損失なので、避けるようにしましょう。
items.speak: Walking away costs both of us, so let's try to avoid that.

items.en: That's a start, but I need more than an apology.
items.jp: それは出発点だが、謝罪以上のものが必要だ。
items.speak: That's a start, but I need more than an apology.

items.en: Make it a year, and I can take it to my director.
items.jp: 1年にしてくれたら、役員に持っていけます。
items.speak: Make it a year, and I can take it to my director.

items.en: A twelve-month term is long. Can we do six, with an option to renew?
items.jp: 12か月は長い。更新の選択肢つきで6か月にできない？
items.speak: A twelve-month term is long. Can we do six, with an option to renew?

items.en: I can do nine. That's as far as I can go.
items.jp: 9か月ならできます。それが限界です。
items.speak: I can do nine. That's as far as I can go.

items.en: Before we sign, I'd like to go over clause fourteen.
items.jp: 署名の前に、14条を確認したいです。
items.speak: Before we sign, I'd like to go over clause fourteen.

items.en: Good catch. That was left out on purpose.
items.jp: いい指摘です。わざと入れていません。
items.speak: Good catch. That was left out on purpose.

items.en: Can you put that in writing, as an appendix?
items.jp: それを、付録として書面にしてもらえますか？
items.speak: Can you put that in writing, as an appendix?

items.en: I'll mark up both changes and send you a clean copy tonight.
items.jp: 両方の変更を反映して、今夜きれいな版を送ります。
items.speak: I'll mark up both changes and send you a clean copy tonight.

items.en: Hey, Ms. Lee, thanks for taking the call on such short notice.
items.jp: リーさん、急なお電話に出ていただきありがとうございます。
items.speak: Hey, Ms. Lee, thanks for taking the call on such short notice.

items.en: Sir, with all due respect, that's not what we agreed to.
items.jp: お言葉ですが、それは合意した内容ではありません。
items.speak: Sir, with all due respect, that's not what we agreed to.

items.en: Boss, the client's pushing back on the delivery date.
items.jp: ボス、お客さんが納期に反対しています。
items.speak: Boss, the client's pushing back on the delivery date.

items.en: Man, they really drive a hard bargain.
items.jp: うわ、向こうは本当に値切りが厳しいな。
items.speak: Man, they really drive a hard bargain.

items.en: Dude, don't accept the first offer. They always come back.
items.jp: なあ、最初の提案は受けるな。向こうは必ず戻ってくる。
items.speak: Dude, don't accept the first offer. They always come back.

items.en: Buddy, you're gonna want that in writing.
items.jp: おい、それは書面にしておきたいはずだよ。
items.speak: Buddy, you're gonna want that in writing.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:念を押す時

items.en: Dunno. We'd have to ask legal about that clause.
items.jp: さあ。その条項は法務に聞かないと。
items.speak: Dunno. We'd have to ask legal about that clause.
items.note: 元の形: I don't know／聞こえ方: ダノウ／使う場面:知らないと言う時

items.en: Beats me why they changed the terms at the last minute.
items.jp: なぜ土壇場で条件を変えたのか分からない。
items.speak: Beats me why they changed the terms at the last minute.
items.note: 元の形: it beats me／聞こえ方: ビーツミー／使う場面:理由が分からない時

items.en: Ya think they'll go for a nine-month term?
items.jp: 9か月の契約を受けると思う？
items.speak: Ya think they'll go for a nine-month term?
items.note: 元の形: do you think／聞こえ方: ヤ シンク／使う場面:予想を聞く時

items.en: Whatcha gonna do if they walk away?
items.jp: 向こうが手を引いたらどうするつもり？
items.speak: Whatcha gonna do if they walk away?
items.note: 元の形: what are you going to／聞こえ方: ワッチャ ガナ／使う場面:行動を聞く時

items.en: Y'know, I think we both wanted the same thing.
items.jp: ほら、お互い同じことを望んでたんだと思うよ。
items.speak: Y'know, I think we both wanted the same thing.
items.note: 元の形: you know／聞こえ方: ヤノウ／使う場面:同意を求める時

items.en: We hafta decide by Friday, or the offer expires.
items.jp: 金曜までに決めなきゃ、提案は失効する。
items.speak: We hafta decide by Friday, or the offer expires.
items.note: 元の形: have to／聞こえ方: ハフタ／使う場面:期限を言う時

items.en: I gotta be straight with you. We can't go any lower.
items.jp: 正直に言わなきゃ。これ以上は下げられない。
items.speak: I gotta be straight with you. We can't go any lower.
items.note: 元の形: have got to／聞こえ方: ガラ／使う場面:本音を言う時

items.en: Long story short, we agreed on nine months at fifteen percent off.
items.jp: 要するに、15%引きで9か月に合意した。
items.speak: Long story short, we agreed on nine months at fifteen percent off.

items.en: Look, I'm not trying to squeeze you. I just need a number I can defend.
items.jp: いいかい、絞り取りたいんじゃない。説明できる数字がほしいだけ。
items.speak: Look, I'm not trying to squeeze you. I just need a number I can defend.

items.en: I mean, it's a fair offer, but it's not a great one.
items.jp: つまり、公平な提案だけど、すごくいいわけじゃない。
items.speak: I mean, it's a fair offer, but it's not a great one.

items.en: Wait, what? They want exclusivity too?
items.jp: 待って、何？独占契約も求めてるの？
items.speak: Wait, what? They want exclusivity too?

items.en: Say again? I think I missed the part about the penalty.
items.jp: もう一度言って？違約金の部分を聞き逃したみたい。
items.speak: Say again? I think I missed the part about the penalty.

items.en: Just talk normally. Skip the legal jargon, please.
items.jp: 普通に話して。法律用語は抜きでお願い。
items.speak: Just talk normally. Skip the legal jargon, please.

items.en: Chill. It's a negotiation, not a fight.
items.jp: 落ち着いて。これは交渉で、けんかじゃない。
items.speak: Chill. It's a negotiation, not a fight.

items.en: No can do. That's outside my authority.
items.jp: それは無理です。私の権限の外です。
items.speak: No can do. That's outside my authority.

items.en: Sounds good. Send me the revised terms by end of day.
items.jp: いいですね。修正した条件を今日中に送ってください。
items.speak: Sounds good. Send me the revised terms by end of day.

items.en: Running behind. Can we push the call to four?
items.jp: 遅れてる。電話を4時にずらせない？
items.speak: Running behind. Can we push the call to four?

items.en: Hey, Ken, can you walk me through the second page?
items.jp: ねえケン、2ページ目を説明してくれる？
items.speak: Hey, Ken, can you walk me through the second page?

items.en: Need a hand with the paperwork?
items.jp: 書類を手伝おうか？
items.speak: Need a hand with the paperwork?

items.en: C'mon, meet me halfway here.
items.jp: ほら、ここは歩み寄ってよ。
items.speak: C'mon, meet me halfway here.
items.note: 元の形: come on／聞こえ方: カモン／使う場面:歩み寄りを求める時

items.en: Didja get the signed copy? I sent it yesterday.
items.jp: 署名済みの写しは届いた？昨日送ったんだけど。
items.speak: Didja get the signed copy? I sent it yesterday.
items.note: 元の形: did you／聞こえ方: ディジャ／使う場面:確認する時

items.en: Any luck getting approval from your director?
items.jp: 役員の承認はもらえた？
items.speak: Any luck getting approval from your director?

items.en: Hey, Dana, can you loop in legal on this thread?
items.jp: ねえダナ、このスレッドに法務も入れてくれる？
items.speak: Hey, Dana, can you loop in legal on this thread?

items.en: Hey, Sam, nice work closing that deal.
items.jp: ねえサム、あの契約をまとめたのはお見事だよ。
items.speak: Hey, Sam, nice work closing that deal.

items.en: Got it. I'll have the contract drafted within the hour.
items.jp: 分かりました。1時間以内に契約書を作成します。
items.speak: Got it. I'll have the contract drafted within the hour.
items.note: 元の形: I've got it／聞こえ方: ガット／使う場面:了解の時

items.en: Mind if I record the call for my notes?
items.jp: メモ用に通話を録音してもいい？
items.speak: Mind if I record the call for my notes?
items.note: 元の形: do you mind／聞こえ方: マインディフ／使う場面:許可を軽くとる時
